item.title: Montessori Baby Toy Sets Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Choking; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys; Sold on Amazon by Chillife Official
item.company: Shenzhenshixingchuangyiyimaoyouxiangongsi (Shenzhen Xingchuangyi Trading Co., Ltd.) dba Chillife Official, China.
item.brand: Shenzhenshixingchuangyiyimaoyouxiangongsi (Shenzhen Xingchuangyi Trading Co., Ltd.) dba Chillife Official, China.
item.summary: This recall involves the Chillife 5-in-1 Montessori Baby Toy Sets. The set comes with a pull string teether toy, circular stacking blocks, a sensory toy, a shape sorting cube with blocks and a suction cup spinner. The violative pull string teething toy has an off-white disc shape with a blue ball in the middle and six long, silicone pull strings of various colors running through the ball. There are also three free-spinning rings and soft push buttons on the disc. “Model: CHILLIFE01” is printed on the side of the product packaging.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Chillife 5-in-1 Montessori Baby Toy Sets.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the pull string teether toys immediately, take them away from children and contact Chillife Official for a partial refund of $5.40. Consumers will be asked to destroy the toy by cutting all silicone strings and writing in permanent marker “DESTROYED” on the main body of the toy and send a photo of the destroyed toy to Chillifebabytoyrecall@outlook.com. Consumers should then dispose of the destroyed product.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
